courses.title: WordPress Website Development
courses.shortDescription: Live online training in wordpress website development for women who want practical, home-friendly skills.
courses.description: LIVE ONLINE TRAINING – NOT A RECORDED COURSE. This one-month Zoom programme focuses on website building, no-code tools and basic web skills. You will attend four live classes each week, complete practical exercises and take part in question-and-answer sessions with the instructor. Enables you to build simple websites, landing pages and maintenance services for local clients. Intakes are planned for the 1st of every month. Exact class days and timings are shared with registered participants after enrolment. Classes are interactive; this is not a pre-recorded video course.
courses.schedule: Four live classes per week. Exact class days and timings will be shared with registered participants.
learningOutcomes: Build simple page layouts with no-code or basic code tools
Publish a starter website or landing page
Edit text, images and navigation
Apply basic mobile-friendly design checks
requirements: Smartphone or computer with a stable internet connection
Willingness to attend scheduled live Zoom sessions
Willingness to try browser-based builders and simple code editors
